description.value: Delhi 6 Indian Bistro is a fine-casual Indian restaurant and bar in Vancouver's Fairview neighbourhood, praised by The Globe and Mail, Vancouver Sun, and Straight.com for its modern take on authentic Indian cuisine. The menu spans fragrant curries, tandoori dishes, handcrafted cocktails, and a dedicated vegan selection. The restaurant also offers full venue hire and catering, making it a well-established local dining destination.

concerns: OSM name is 'Delhi 6' but the business consistently identifies itself as 'Delhi 6 Indian Bistro' on its website.
OSM record has no phone number; website provides 604-742-3311 and info@delhi6.ca.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-reviewed, active Indian restaurant with confirmed takeout and vegan options on a major Vancouver cycling corridor (W 7th Ave); a useful food stop for touring cyclists.
